definition: Impossible to calm, persuade, or satisfy, even after repeated attempts.
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
quote: It is no wonder that he and his family have some of the more implacable spirits upon their track.
example_sentence: The ticket inspector was implacable, however sweetly we smiled.
